sourceQualifiedAssertions: qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts runs one automatic and one warm process per original parent, validates both completed/cleaned and all three named proof markers before publishing one top-level receipt.

registered-process-linux.native.mjs original isolated-launch prelude confirms same child PID/group/argv0/arguments/cwd/env/stdin/stdout/stderr, exact injected FD64 removal in child and descendant, original parent FD identity/use, missing/denied exec errno2/13 with 12-byte status and exit111, target exit111 distinguished, ENOEXEC script semantics, and original-child SIGTERM; these helper actions are separate from the later custody-phase nativeSignalCalls:1 field.

The retained custody phase refuses unrelated peer capture, wrong pidfd/capture key, namespace mismatch, orphan readmission, changed target/session and a live worker after thread leader exit; persisted original capture remains byte-exact.

Automatic version3 permits original cold read/signal; warm version4 refuses cold observation/signaling and only its original retained owner signals. Each exact target becomes absent while peer and same-session sibling remain same-live.

The original finally awaits root close events, requires every actor closed marker and every retained capture absent/stale within its unchanged15s cleanup loop; finite-cleanup true follows those predicates. This is not a general census of every machine process.

linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs exercises normal/fallback high-socket closure under Node24 and Electron parent against the same selected Node target, original PID/group/argv/env/stdio and FD52/4096 absence, unexpected close_range refusal, original-child Stop and sibling survival, changed manifest/image refusal, and all original child close promises before private fixture removal.

POSIX lifecycle output includes both the original cleanupConfirmed:true case and the deliberate cleanupConfirmed:false refusal case; the latter still separately asserts eventual TEST descendant absence and neighbor preservation. It is not promoted to a confirmed product cleanup result.
qualificationLimits: PASS is for these exact Linux x64 finite native/process fixtures on the retained kernel/runtime tuples; SDK/native-provider business execution, Desktop, release, Darwin registration and executable-byte race acceptance remain explicitly false in scope.json.
